verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents an official self-hosted MCP server with OAuth (bugsnag-docs-21, bugsnag-probe-3) and provides stack traces, error grouping, and automatic assignment rules (bugsnag-docs-1, bugsnag-docs-2) that could support agent-driven triage, plus webhook/Slack/PagerDuty integrations for downstream action (bugsnag-docs-7-10). However, there's no evidence of a documented REST/OpenAPI spec (probe shows 404s) or explicit tracker-filing integration (e.g., Jira) that an agent could use to 'file the real bugs,' so the full pipeline described is only partially evidenced. missing for 10: explicit REST/OpenAPI API docs, direct evidence of ticket/tracker-filing integration (e.g., Jira), and a concrete example of an agent using the MCP server to triage and file bugs end-to-end.
